events.event_name: 18th Annual Urban Bear NYC Street Fair
events.address: Little West 12th Street between Washington Street and 10th Avenue, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: The Urban Bear's annual outdoor Meatpacking District street fair with DJ NOBL3 B3AR, vendors and community programming.
events.what_is_free: No free general-admission claim is supported by the current official schedule; the official 2026 page lists the Street Fair at $20.
events.caveats: Some third-party guides describe the street fair as free, but the current organizer page lists Sunday Sept. 20, 1–7 PM / $20. The official organizer source controls this listing.
events.practical_notes: Enter from Washington Street. This is the street-fair occurrence, not the separate free 6 PM closing party at Rockbar.

events.address: Vanderbilt Hall, Grand Central Terminal, 89 E 42nd St, New York, NY 10017
events.what_it_is: A Tatcha skin-and-mind pop-up with product discovery, samples, self-guided meditation and limited guided meditation sessions.
events.what_is_free: Public pop-up access, product discovery, samples and self-guided meditation are advertised as free. Limited guided sessions require advance sign-up.
events.caveats: Special 10-minute guided meditation sessions have limited space and require sign-up. Self-guided meditation spots are available by reservation or first come, first served; do not imply a reservation guarantees every component.
events.practical_notes: Monday hours are 9 AM–7 PM; Tuesday hours are 8 AM–7 PM. Vanderbilt Hall inside Grand Central Terminal.

events.event_name: Light Hill: Art into Action, Educational Gallery
events.what_it_is: A week-long Climate Week educational gallery pop-up using art and data to make methane pollution visible and actionable.
events.what_is_free: The official Climate Week NYC listing states the gallery is free and open to the public.
events.caveats: The official listing offers a Register now action but also explicitly describes the exhibit as free and open to the public; no advance-registration requirement is stated in the verified listing.
events.practical_notes: Open daily Sept. 21–27 from 11 AM–6 PM at 74 Franklin Street.

events.address: Bogardus Plaza, 5 Hudson St, New York, NY 10013
events.what_it_is: A one-day OXO Climate Week pop-up with complimentary coffee, chef-curated bites, sustainability programming and giveaways.
events.what_is_free: Attendance, coffee and chef-curated bites are complimentary. Swivel Peelers are available while supplies last; Rapid Brewers are limited to the first 50 qualifying guests.
events.caveats: The event is open to the public. RSVP is tied to eligibility for the limited Rapid Brewer giveaway, not established as a requirement to attend. Giveaway quantities are limited.
events.practical_notes: Thursday Sept. 24, 11 AM–4 PM at Bogardus Plaza. RSVP for the Rapid Brewer giveaway; general attendance is public.
